title: Effect target selection uses friendly units already on the board instead of units in hand
expected: Card def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/here-to-help.ts:15-21) is `{type:"play", from:"hand", target:{controller:"friendly", type:"unit"}}`. play-spell.ts does not special-case play-from-hand: (1) condition at play-spell.ts:235-242 calls spellEffectHasLegalTargets -> targetDescriptorIsSatisfiable -> resolveTarget, which scans only board zones (target-resolver.ts:182 getBoardCardIds = base + battlefields, lines 319-343), so with no friendly unit on board the spell is illegal; (2) enumerator at play-spell.ts:457-471 treats effect.target as a caster-chosen card target and emits one Play per friendly board unit; (3) play-spell.ts:248-267 rejects any supplied targets[0] not in the board pool, so a hand unit target is refused. Only chain/resolve.ts:153-155 exempts `play`+`from:"hand"` from board targeting (at resolution), not the play-time gate/enumerator.
observed: playSpell for Here to Help was enumerated only with targets = friendly units on the board (Punching Poro at bf, Flame Chompers in base, Gust Monk at bf); executeMove with a hand unit as target was rejected (no state change). With no friendly unit on board the spell was not castable at all despite 10 energy and 3 units in hand.
